howto.what: Claude使用ultrawork模式将工作分解为系统化、有证据支撑的步骤，要求先读取工作流程文件，严格遵循引导、执行循环和停止规则，每一步都必须记录真实证据。
howto.when: 当用户提到'ulw-loop'、'ulw'、'durable goal execution'等关键词，或要求基于证据的工作、手动质量检查或长时间运行交付时触发。

say.note: Claude会启动目标导向循环，分解任务并记录每一步证据。

say.text: 启动耐用目标执行模式。
say.note: Claude将按照证据绑定的步骤执行工作。

say.text: 帮我用证据驱动的方式完成这个工作。

howto.what_en: Claude uses ultrawork mode to break down work into systematic, evidence-bound steps. It must first read the workflow file, then strictly follow bootstrap, execution loop, and stop rules, recording real evidence for every step.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'ulw-loop', 'ulw', 'durable goal execution', or asks for evidence-led work, manual QA, or checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break down this task.
say_en.note: Claude starts the goal-oriented loop and records evidence.

say_en.text: Help me complete this work with evidence-driven approach.
